system.summary: Homophonic substitution of graphic signs for German (short Latin passages); day numbers and year in plain digits.
system.notes: From Kopal & Waldispühl 2023; same key as letter D (ff. 205-208), not the key of Maximilian's 1575 letters.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code with Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Read the HistoCrypt 2023 article cited on the DECODE record: R1473 = their letter E (Chiffrenschlüssel fasc. 20 kt 210-212, Szklow 22 Feb 1575), deciphered completely; plaintext deposited on DECODE.

outcome.method_basis: Kopal and Waldispuehl (HistoCrypt 2023) had deciphered the letter in full and put the plaintext on the DECODE record R1473; the project confirmed this from the paper without viewing the images.
outcome.notes: Found solved by Kopal & Waldispühl 2023; nothing added. Catalogue entry 268 removed; no write-up.
